tools.name: audit_system
tools.description: Grade a signal or expert by its real closed trades: grade A-F, profit factor, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, yearly results, red/yellow flags (martingale, grid, overfit, look-ahead, few trades) and, for MQL5 Market products, the result after the current version came out. Takes a link or a history file.

tools.name: prop_chance
tools.description: Monte Carlo of a system's trades through a prop-firm challenge (FTMO, The5ers, FundedNext presets or generic rules): chance to pass, chance of zero passes, survival when funded, worst day, expected fees per pass.

tools.name: compare_systems
tools.description: Side-by-side audit grade, profit factor, post-release result and prop pass chance for 2-3 links.

tools.name: list_prop_programmes
tools.description: Prop-firm programmes and generic rule sets Strata can simulate, with their limits and fees.

tools.name: top_systems
tools.description: The best systems in the Strata rating (public sources, graded by the same audit), optionally by site.
